name: B10-0072/2024 (Renew) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
title: Resolution on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian interference ahead of the upcoming presidential elections and a constitutional referendum on EU integration
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to help Moldova defend itself against Russian interference before its presidential election and its referendum on joining the European Union on 20 October 2024. It asks for more support against disinformation and cyberattacks, new sanctions on people who undermine Moldova, and faster work on Moldova's European Union membership. The text is the Parliament's position and request; it does not by itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament asks the European Union to act; it does not decide.
- **Who it affects:** Moldova's government and voters, and the European Union and its member states.
- **What happens next:** The Council and the European Union's foreign policy chief receive the request and decide whether to act.
